call_2_changes.text:
{"changes": [
  {"change": "modified", "requirement_id": "R-001", "new_text": "An on-board odometer complying with the requirements of this UN Regulation shall be fitted to the vehicle to be approved.", "new_paragraph": "5.1"},
  {"change": "added", "new_text": "For vehicles other than those of category X or category Y, an on-board speedometer complying with the requirements of this UN Regulation shall be fitted.", "new_paragraph": "5.1"},
  {"change": "added", "new_text": "For vehicles of category X or category Y, a speedometer may be fitted, but is not required to meet the requirements of this Regulation.", "new_paragraph": "5.1"},
  {"change": "modified", "requirement_id": "R-002", "new_text": "If more than one on-board speedometer or odometer is fitted to the vehicle, all these speedometers and odometers shall comply with all the requirements of this UN Regulation when displayed.", "new_paragraph": "5.1"},
  {"change": "added", "new_text": "For vehicles fitted with an ADS complying with the provisions on indicators of UN Regulation No [XXX], a speedometer complying to this UN Regulation is not required to indicate the speed while an ADS feature is active.", "new_paragraph": "5.2"},
  {"change": "modified", "requirement_id": "R-038", "new_text": "The display of the odometer shall be visible or accessible to a driver, if applicable, or any authorised person.", "new_paragraph": "5.5"},
  {"change": "modified", "requirement_id": "R-043", "new_text": "If a setting makes it possible for a driver or ADS to select the odometer display distance in km or miles independently of the speedometer, the odometer shall identify the unit used.", "new_paragraph": "5.5.2"},
  {"change": "modified", "requirement_id": "R-052", "new_text": "In the case of an electrically detectable failure preventing the odometer requirements of this UN Regulation from being met, a malfunction indication shall be provided to the driver, if applicable, if not already covered by other failure warnings and/or other failure conditions.", "new_paragraph": "5.11"},
  {"change": "added", "new_text": "In case of vehicles of categories X and Y and vehicles where an ADSF-2 is active, the malfunction shall be transmitted as a logic signal to the ADS.", "new_paragraph": "5.11"}
]}
